def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    if k <= 0:
        return [0] * n

    unique_sorted = sorted(set(a))
    rank_map = {v: idx + 1 for idx, v in enumerate(unique_sorted)}
    ranks = [rank_map[x] for x in a]

    m = len(unique_sorted)
    bit = [0] * (m + 1)
    res = [0] * n

    for i, r in enumerate(ranks):
        if i > k:
            j = ranks[i - k - 1]
            while j <= m:
                bit[j] -= 1
                j += j & -j

        le_count = 0
        j = r
        while j > 0:
            le_count += bit[j]
            j -= j & -j

        window_size = i if i < k else k
        res[i] = window_size - le_count

        j = r
        while j <= m:
            bit[j] += 1
            j += j & -j

    return res
